name: harddrive-cleanup
description: Safe, unattended Windows 10/11 C: drive cleanup: clears program caches, old temp files, the Windows Update download cache and superseded Windows components, with a live progress screen.
description_good_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/README.md - the README opens by saying what the program does: a safe, unattended cleanup of caches and old temp files on a Windows 10/11 C: drive.
interact_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/README.md - Download (releases), Contributing and Security sections; bug reports via https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/issues.
contribution_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md - fork, branch, pull request against main, review and required CI checks.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md - the safety rules every change must keep, code style (ASCII, CRLF, StrictMode 2, PowerShell 5.1 and 7) and the testing steps.
floss_license_justification: The software is released under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, which permits personal and other non-commercial use only. It is source-available, not FLOSS.
documentation_basics_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/README.md - what it clears, what it never does, how to run it, requirements.
documentation_interface_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/README.md - the command-line switches table (-DryRun, -NoElevate, -NoWait), exit behaviour and log locations; the script's comment-based help (Get-Help) documents every parameter.
sites_https_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup - GitHub repository, issues and release downloads are HTTPS-only.
discussion_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/issues and https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/pulls - searchable, URL-addressable, open to anyone with a GitHub account, no proprietary client needed.
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and bug reports and code comments are accepted in English.
maintained_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/commits/main - actively maintained; Dependabot updates merge automatically after CI.
repo_track_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/commits/main - git records each change, its author and its date.
repo_interim_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/commits/main - every change is committed between releases, not only releases.
version_unique_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/releases - each release has a unique version (v1.0.0, v1.0.1).
version_tags_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/tags - each release is an annotated git tag; pushing the tag builds the release.
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/releases - each release has a human-readable summary of changes and upgrade impact.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerability has been fixed in any release so far; release notes state this explicitly.
report_process_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/issues/new/choose - bug report and feature request forms.
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been received yet; the maintainer responds to reports through GitHub issues.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been received yet; the maintainer responds to them through GitHub issues.
report_archive_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/issues?q=is%3Aissue - GitHub keeps every issue and response publicly searchable.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/SECURITY.md - GitHub private vulnerability reporting (https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/security/advisories/new) or email to the maintainer.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received in the last 6 months.
build_justification: The software is a PowerShell script and a batch launcher; there is nothing to build.
test_justification: An automated test suite exists (https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/tests/Invoke-Tests.ps1, run by CI on every change), but like the rest of the repository it is under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so it is not released as FLOSS.
test_invocation_justification: The suite is a plain PowerShell script run with 'powershell -File tests/Invoke-Tests.ps1' (https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), not Pester, the standard PowerShell test framework.
test_most_justification: The tests cover the delete engine's safety rules, the path guards, parsing, file format and a dry run end to end, but not the console display, the Windows Update service handling or DISM.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/actions/workflows/ci.yml - tests on Windows Server 2022 and 2025, in PowerShell 5.1 and 7, on every push and pull request.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md - 'If you add a safety rule, add a test for it here.'
tests_are_added_justification: https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/pull/1 - the most recent change to the safety behaviour came with test changes; the test suite was added with the CI/CD change.
warnings_justification: PSScriptAnalyzer runs on every change (https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/actions/workflows/ci.yml); findings also go to GitHub code scanning.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any PSScriptAnalyzer finding; the codebase has zero.
warnings_strict_justification: All rules at every severity; the three exclusions are listed with reasons in https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/blob/main/PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1.
crypto_random_justification: The software generates no keys or nonces.
delivery_unsigned_justification: The SHA-256 checksum is delivered over HTTPS beside the release, and each release carries a Sigstore-signed build provenance attestation (gh attestation verify).
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: There are no known unpatched vulnerabilities.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerabilities have been reported.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The repository holds no credentials; GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled.
static_analysis_justification: PSScriptAnalyzer on the PowerShell and CodeQL on the GitHub Actions workflows, on every change (https://github.com/RichardZak70/harddrive-cleanup/actions).
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: PSScriptAnalyzer includes security rules (for example PSAvoidUsingInvokeExpression, PSAvoidUsingPlainTextForPassword); CodeQL runs its security-extended queries on the workflows.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: No open findings; CI blocks a merge while any PSScriptAnalyzer finding exists.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs on every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No dynamic analysis tool (fuzzer or scanner) is applied.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dynamic analysis configuration is used.
